reviews.text: I had my first Reiki session with Stella last week. Not knowing what to expect, I was nervous but Stella made me feel very comfortable with her soothing presence and attention to detail to make the room and the session a very comfortable space.   Even though I have trouble with visualization type exercises I was still able to have a powerful emotional release. Her room is so cute and you just feel zen the moment you step in it.   I will definitely return to continue my work and I would recommend Stella to anyone looking to do some emotional and/or spiritual healing/energy work.  Thank you Stella 🩷

I had my first foot detox bath and my first Reiki session with Stella and I loved it. She is very knowledgeable, calming and has created a very soothing and a peaceful space.  I also bought some of her unique gifts and bracelets.
Definitely will be booking more sessions with Stella!

Stella's light was my first Reiki session, and it was amazing. After the session, I felt so relaxed, calm, and at ease. I will definitely come back again.
During my visit, I also pursued two bracelets she recommended. Stella took the time to explain everything to me and answered all of my questions. I truly appreciate her guidance and knowledge. I look forward to returning for more sessions in the future❤️
